title.en: SAMPLE: A robotic lab finds a cheap metal mixture that splits water
title.zh: SAMPLE：機器人實驗室找到能分解水的廉價金屬混合物

found.en: A robotic lab at Eastvale University tested 200 mixtures of common metals in six weeks. One mixture sped up the splitting of water into hydrogen almost as well as platinum does.
found.zh: Eastvale University 的機器人實驗室在六週內測試了 200 種常見金屬的混合物。其中一種混合物加快水分解成氫的效果，幾乎和鉑一樣好。

matters.en: Platinum is rare. A cheap mixture that works nearly as well could make hydrogen from water less costly.
matters.zh: 鉑很稀少。一種效果幾乎一樣好的廉價混合物，可能讓從水製氫的成本降低。

ai_helped.en: Marlow Labs built Marlow Selector, which chose which mixtures to try next. Robot arms mixed and tested the samples.
ai_helped.zh: Marlow Labs 開發了 Marlow Selector，由它挑選接下來要嘗試的混合物。機器手臂混合並測試這些樣本。

how_sure.en: Checked. The Eastvale Journal of Materials published the paper. The tests ran in one lab, and Marlow Labs, the maker of the AI system, helped write it.
how_sure.zh: 已查核。Eastvale Journal of Materials 發表了這篇論文。測試在一間實驗室進行，AI 系統的開發者 Marlow Labs 也參與撰寫。

background.en: Splitting water gives hydrogen. The reaction needs a material that speeds it up, and platinum is a common choice.
background.zh: 分解水會得到氫。這個反應需要一種加快反應的材料，鉑是常見的選擇。

could_lead.en: Robot labs could search many more mixtures in the same time and find other cheap materials.
could_lead.zh: 機器人實驗室可能在同樣的時間內搜尋更多混合物，找到其他廉價材料。

evidence.quote: Marlow Selector, built by Marlow Labs, chose which mixtures to try next

note.en: An independent lab repeated the work and got a matching result.
note.zh: 一間獨立實驗室重複了這項研究，得到相符的結果。
